description: Temps de parcours et sens de circulation du pont de Saint-Nazaire (temps réel) is a dataset listed in Loire-Atlantique - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de Loire-Atlantique. Indication du sens de circulation en cours et à venir des trois voies de l'ouvrage pour la traversée du pont de Saint-Nazaire, e t estimation du temps de parcourspour la traversée du pont de Saint-Nazaire. The portal shows 2020-12-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-loire-atlantique-fr-portal.
